review_evidence: HexRowReduceMathlib/RankSpanNullspace.lean proves spanContains_iff_mem_span and correspondence between executable span coefficients and Mathlib linear combinations.
The module proves nullspace vectors lie in the kernel and that their span equals the kernel.
It also proves the executable row-reduction rank agrees with the Mathlib rank notion.
summary: Retain hex-row-reduce-mathlib as the substantive Mathlib bridge for span, kernel/nullspace, and rank correctness of row reduction.
